page_title: LEV 4-3 WOL | Bayer Leverkusen v Wolfsburg 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
90+7' It's like he was asking for a caution. Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card.
90+6' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen get a free kick.
90+3' 4 - 3 Goal! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 4:3.
90+3' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen).

90+3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
90+2' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) must leave the pitch due to his teammate's red card and Denis Vavro comes onto the pitch.
90+1' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+1' Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

90+1' Good touch by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) as he latched on to an accurate pass before attempting to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range shot. Unluckily for him, his attempt only rattles the left post.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
88' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
88' Red card! Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) simply can't believe his eyes. The referee makes the call and sends him off.
87' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle after Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
83' The ball is cleared after Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Granit Xhaka, but he puts too much power on the pass.
82' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
81' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
80' The referee is firm and issues Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) a deserved yellow card.
79' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Aleix Garcia is replaced by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen).
78' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Piero Hincapie, but his close-range header slips just over the bar.
77' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

77' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Kamil Grabara is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
76' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Piero Hincapie. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
74' Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well wide of the left post.
71' Substitution. Mattias Svanberg did his best and is replaced by Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg).
71' Here comes a substitution. Patrick Wimmer is given a rest as he is replaced by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).
71' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Tiago Tomas and he is replaced by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Patrik Schick as he is replaced by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen).
66' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
65' Sascha Stegemann interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg).
63' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
62' A pass from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Kamil Grabara and the move breaks down.
60' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
59' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
57' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Sascha Stegemann signals.
56' The substitution has been made. Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) has replaced Amine Adli.
55' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it flies just over the bar.
53' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
51' This is a yellow card! Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
50' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
50' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

49' 3 - 3 Aleix Garcia sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen), who outjumps the defence to put the ball into the roof of the net with a stunning header. The score is 3:3.
48' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner.

48' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
46' Half-time substitution. Xabi Alonso decided to make a change. Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) is replaced by Piero Hincapie.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Xabi Alonso probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen). He is replaced by Jeremie Frimpong.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Sascha Stegemann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' The referee shows a yellow card to Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
45+3' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
45+1' 2 - 3 What a beauty from just outside the box! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
42' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) will replace Ridle Baku.
41' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Lukas Hradecky easily deals with the threat.
39' Half-chance! Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a pass into the box, but Kamil Grabara reacts well to snuff out the attack.

37' 2 - 2 Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Jakub Kaminski. His bullet header went towards the middle of the goal and behind the goalkeeper. It's 2:2.
37' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
36' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Wolfsburg have a corner.
36' Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
32' 2 - 1 Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 2:1.
32' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take a corner kick.

31' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the right side of the goal, but great anticipation by Kamil Grabara allowed him to make a comfortable save. Bayer Leverkusen force their opponents to concede a corner.
31' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) a chance inside the box, but his efforts zips just over the bar.

30' What an opportunity! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes low towards the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
29' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
28' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' The game is interrupted now, Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Patrik Schick.
26' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
24' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
22' Ridle Baku almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' What a chance! The ball is inside the box and Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a first-time shot on goal, but his volley goes narrowly wide of the right post.
17' No foul! Referee Sascha Stegemann points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Bayer Leverkusen players.
16' Wait! Referee Sascha Stegemann has indicated he is going to review the Bayer Leverkusen goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
14' 1 - 1 Goal! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the left post. It's 1:1.
14' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender.
13' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) brings his opponent down. Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bayer Leverkusen.
12' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Bayer Leverkusen for a penalty. Play continues.
12' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

10' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Lukas Hradecky with a brilliant diving save!
9' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
7' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
7' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
7' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
5' 0 - 1 Own goal! Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 0:1.

4' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
3' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
2' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolfsburg can continue in their attacking effort.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayer Leverkusen will have the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann will referee today's match.
